QF.id: XIII Introduction to Forwards and Futures_26

question.text: If USDINR spot is Rs 84.50, India rate 7.5%, US rate 4.5%, what is the theoretical 6-month futures price?

explanation.text: The Logic: Interest Rate Parity: F = S x (1 + RINR x t) / (1 + RUSD x t) = 84.50 x (1 + 0.075 x 0.5) / (1 + 0.045 x 0.5) = 84.50 x 1.0375 / 1.0225 = 84.50 x 1.01468 = 85.7396, rounded to Rs 85.74. The Trap: Rs 83.27 inverts the ratio; Rs 87.04 applies the full annual differential without time-scaling; Rs 84.50 assumes no carry cost. Note: Keep rounding consistent — 85.7396 rounds to Rs 85.74 at two decimal places.
